intent: Review the active TEA2209T/IPW60R017C7/F2 source contract, current-waveform adapter, domain and loop checks, and runner integration without reusing passive GBJ evidence.

findings.title: Edited PCB is not rebound to native and stackup evidence
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate native, stackup, DRC, final-artifact and source-manifest hash bindings from the repaired PCB bytes, then run the active units common suite.
findings.first_evidence: candidate/section.kicad_pcb:38330 -- route width changes while retained receipts still bind the prior board hash
findings.why_it_matters: The current board cannot pass the board/native binding gates until all evidence is regenerated for the same bytes.
evidence: Current board hash differs from native.json, source-manifest.json and rust-stackup.json retained hashes.

findings.title: Part-contract census can silently omit an identity
findings.suggested_fix: Validate uniqueness and set equality between EXPECTED_PARTS IDs and COMPONENT_IDS before exact_part checks, or replace the parallel slices with one authoritative keyed map.
findings.first_evidence: power_entry_active.rs:465 -- validation checks only EXPECTED_PARTS.len()==COMPONENT_IDS.len() before iterating exact_part
findings.why_it_matters: A duplicate part tuple can leave one component's MPN/value unchecked while the source census still passes.
evidence: The component presence loop and part loop use separate arrays without duplicate or coverage checks.

findings.title: Active dispatch lacks production-shaped end-to-end tests
findings.suggested_fix: Add an end-to-end runner::run test using the active units manifest, asserting active model-gap statuses and rejection when passive evidence is supplied.
findings.first_evidence: runner.rs:605 -- active branch suppresses passive reports, but only the helper is exercised by tests
findings.why_it_matters: Module-level KCL and the new P1 fixture test can pass while runner dispatch silently re-enables passive qualification or skips active obligations.
evidence: The new fixture-backed p1::run test now covers active binding; runner tests still exercise the legacy units manifest and active_model_gap helper only.

residual_risks: Final native/manufacturing evidence must be regenerated and hash-bound after the routing repair; current tracked native.json is for an earlier board hash.
The current common run reports unresolved finite-width contact/KCL on RECTIFIER_L; copper repair and a fresh full run are still required.
The active unit remains electrically/model-wise unqualified for thermal, loss, protection coordination, and physical operation.
testing_gaps: Final board common-suite run was not reviewed because routing/evidence repair is still in flight.
No production-shaped active P1/runner test exercises the new units manifest and model-gap suppression.

coverage.note: Correctness and project-standards reviewers ran. Full runner/KiCad execution remains deferred until repaired-board evidence is regenerated.
